verdict: Paid ads have been dark for 19 days; action is underway.
narrative: Meta ads ran actively from July 28 through August 5, producing all 27 leads this period at a cost of $24.43 per lead — then spend stopped and has been at zero for the 19 days since. Your Google Business Profile has continued to generate activity in the meantime, recording 172 actions and 58 calls this period, making it your only active lead surface right now. The 27 leads that did arrive were not followed up in the system, so we are closing that intake gap with SMS automation and call-handling tools going live by August 31. Expect paid ads to resume alongside those fixes, and a retargeting audience will be in place by end of September to recapture earlier interest.
